data.text:
Ramesh Kachawana, vs The Commissioner Of Food Safety, on 
28 October, 2024 
Author: K.Lakshman Bench: K.Lakshman  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE S.V. BHATT  CIVIL REVISION PETITION No.3925 OF 2013 ORDER: 
Sri Syed Yasar Mamoon, learned counsel for the petitioners, requests the Court to permit him to withdraw the Civil Revision Petition with liberty to pursue the remedy available in law. 
2. Permission granted, as prayed for. The Civil Revision Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. 
3. Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending, shall also stand dismissed. 
________________ S.V. BHATT, J 06.12.2013.
